Indian Stamp Act, 1899-Section 27, 35, 47A-Circular issued by State directing the authorities to register documents after inspection of C property (Ind collection of amount-Validity of-Held, violative of the provisions of the Act-Tamil Nadu Stamp (Prevention of Under Valuation of Instruments) to refuse registration of documents relating to property if, after inspection, the value disclosed is D found undervalued and that registration should be done only after collecting the stamp duty on correct valuation. Respondents challenged the circular by filing writ petitions before the
